name: splicewire/laravel-beam-versioning
description: The HTTP + DTO seam over rushing/laravel-versioning: a single generic versions controller (list / save / restore, roll-forward), a Route::recordVersions() macro that registers the REST triplet for any Versionable model, and the record-agnostic VersionData / VersionInputData projections. Authorization delegates to the host model's existing policy via the macro's ability map. A capability peer of the beam family (ADR-0116 mirrored pair with @splicewire/beam-versioning); the raw VersionStore mechanism stays pure in rushing/laravel-versioning.

suggest.schemastud/laravel-data-schemas: The VersionData / VersionInputData projections carry #[Description]/#[Example] annotations for schema + API-doc generation. Only reflected by a schema/Scribe host (never at request time — spatie/laravel-data never instantiates foreign attributes), so the package runs without it; an engine-tier host (which has it) documents the endpoints with field descriptions.
suggest.rushing/laravel-data-schemas-scribe: The VersionsController methods carry #[RequestFromData]/#[ResponseFromData] so the versions triplet self-documents under Scribe. Only reflected by `scribe:generate` (never at request time), so the package runs without it; a Scribe host generates the endpoint docs.
